episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: A team of scientists are thrust into a potentially life-or-death situation after being deployed to the Arctic to secretly investigate what could be a disease outbreak.

episodes.title: Vector
episodes.summary: Dr. Alan Farragut and his team work to treat the outbreak patients and contain the virus, while at the same time a rebellion erupts at the Arctic Biosystems base.
The team have every hope that the virus is contained, but unfortunately it continues to spread at an alarming rate; at the same time, some of the secrets the docs are keeping prove to be deadly.

episodes.title: Single Strand
episodes.summary: Alan and the team deal with secrets and suspicion as the crisis heightens and deadly consequences follow. Meanwhile, Walker tries to survive on Level R.

episodes.title: The White Room
episodes.summary: Members of the CDC team come to the realization that nobody is who they seem to be at the base.

episodes.title: Aniqatiga
episodes.summary: Alan and Jordan make progress in decoding the virus; Hatake secretly "cures" Walker before the corporation's black helicopters land on the base.

episodes.title: Survivor Zero
episodes.summary: Daniel makes a discovery; Hatake protects Walker from Sutton's mercenaries.

episodes.title: Bloodline
episodes.summary: The vectors attack and take Peter's body; Walker is held prisoner by Sutton after the true nature of Sutton's relationship with Hatake is revealed.

episodes.title: Level X
episodes.summary: Secrets come to the light and unlikely alliances are established; at the same time, Alan and Walker take on a dangerous mission to destroy what's left of the NARVIK virus.

episodes.title: Fushigi
episodes.summary: Alan and Julia travel to an abandoned satellite station in a last-ditch effort to call for help. Once there, they come across the truth behind Hatake's plan and Julia's condition. Meanwhile, Dr. Jordan makes a startling discovery of her own, which could mean a cure for cancer.

episodes.title: Black Rain
episodes.summary: Peter leads the Vectors in a desperate final attempt to spread the virus, while the CDC scientists work together and successfully create a cure just as their lives come under threat from Ilaria Corporation's deadly mercenaries.

episodes.title: The Reaping
episodes.summary: Alan, Walker, Hatake and Daniel set a trap for an assassin who has been sent by Ilaria to retrieve both the virus and the cure.

episodes.title: Dans L'Ombre
episodes.summary: In the Season 1 finale, Alan and Walker battle the Scythe to save the world from disaster.

episodes.title: San Jose
episodes.summary: In the second-season premiere, Drs. Peter Farragut and Sarah Jordan are joined by Kyle Sommer when they battle a new deadly virus on a mysterious wooded island.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: The CDC team continue to investigate the island; at the same time, they discover Peter's brother, Alan, is a member of Brother Michael's cult, and his warnings for them to leave the abbey fall on deaf ears.

episodes.title: Scion
episodes.summary: Jordan and Peter travel outside the safety of the abbey to retrieve some specimens and discover just what's living in the woods; at the same time, Sister Amy plots to make the CDC team leave forever.

episodes.title: Densho
episodes.summary: Michael struggles to keep the abbey under control as the CDC team move closer toward tracking the source of the pathogen; at the same time, Alan fights the urge to rejoin his former colleagues and comes to terms with the reality about Peter's allegiances. In the future, Walker takes a risk attempting to escape her delusional father.

episodes.title: Oubliette
episodes.summary: Peter reveals is brother's secret and gets them both in trouble; at the same time, Kyle has his hands full trying to quarantine the orchard and the infected hive.

episodes.title: M. Domestica
episodes.summary: The CDC team are forced to work together when another outbreak threatens to overwhelm the Abbey.

episodes.title: Cross-Pollination
episodes.summary: Things go from bad to worse on the island. Elsewhere, Walker decides to go to St. Germain after learning about Brother Michael.

episodes.title: Vade in Pace
episodes.summary: Sister Amy makes a power play for control of the Abbey as Alan and Kyle discover a possible cure for the virus.

episodes.title: Ectogenesis
episodes.summary: Alan, Kyle and Winger search the woods for the tree with red sap that might be a cure for the pathogen.

episodes.title: Mother
episodes.summary: At the abbey, Sister Amy makes a bargain for immortality; and in the woods, the race to find the Bleeding Tree intensifies now that Kyle is infected.

episodes.title: Plan B
episodes.summary: The Navy prepare to implement Plan B, a final solution to ensure that the virus and everyone infected with it never make it off the island.

episodes.title: The Ascendant
episodes.summary: Kyle and Jordan attempt to flee the island, but their escape is made more difficult by the followers who are hunting them down; Walker and Alan plan to halt ILARIA's deadly plan as soon as they find the Mother Tree.

episodes.title: O Brave New World
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 finale, Alan's relationship with Walker reaches a bloody climax, while his sibling feud with Peter erupts in flames. Elsewhere, Kyle does his best to protect a possible cure for the mycosis.
